messages:
Kelly (People Ops): Hi @Owen — small, manager-focused first-week + 30/60/90 checklist for Ivy who starts Mon. Made it checklist-friendly for calendar nudges. Please confirm owners.

Owen (Hiring Manager): Thanks Kelly. I can own code onboarding, pairing schedule, and 30/60/90 outcomes.

Kelly (People Ops): Pasteable first-week plan:
Day -1 (pre-start): laptop shipped, SSO invite, badge request, calendar shared
Day 1 AM: HR paperwork + payroll, manager 1:1 (role context + expectations)
Day 1 PM: team standup + intros, mentor intro, verify VPN & badge
Day 2: product roadmap + customer context, architecture docs, read-only repo access
Day 3: dev workflow & CI demo, local setup pairing, assign first small ticket
Day 4: observability + deploy runbook, security signoff (training attestation)
